subject: NimbusHealth: coordinating security onboarding session and procurement sync
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@NimbusHealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@NimbusHealth.com, security@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: security review + onboarding window for Redwood integration

Hi David —

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. NimbusHealth is prioritizing the security review for any new vendor integrations. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute technical security review that includes: Nimbus security (app + infra), our procurement lead, and Redwood security/AE/SE to walk through architecture, data flows, and the SOC2 controls mapping.

High level asks:
- 45-minute session: 30m technical + 15m procurement Q&A
- Provide SOC2 summary & access control/SSO details ahead of time
- Share a short attendee list and an architecture diagram if possible

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 30 Nov: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed 1 Dec: 09:00–09:45 or 14:00–14:45

I attached our baseline questionnaire (nimbus_security_questionnaire.xlsx) — can you confirm who from Redwood should join and which of the proposed windows works? Procurement will join the first 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Integrations
NimbusHealth

Attachments: nimbus_security_questionnaire.xlsx

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 18:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review + onboarding window for Redwood integration

Alex — great, thanks for the clear asks and the questionnaire. Monica (AE) and I will own the coordination. I'm looping in Markus Klein (security/SE) from Redwood who can cover SOC2 controls, architecture, and SSO patterns.

Proposed session we can book now (45m):
- Option A: Tue 30 Nov 15:00–15:45 PST (preferred)
- Option B: Wed 1 Dec 09:00–09:45 PST

Suggested agenda (we'll keep to 45m):
1) 5m intros / scope (AE + customer lead)
2) 25m technical walkthrough (Markus) — data flows, KV caching, model inference boundaries, logging/retention
3) 10m controls mapping / SOC2 highlights (Markus)
4) 5m procurement items + next steps (procurement lead)

I'll attach a short Redwood security readme with pointers to SOC2 and our evidence flow. If you can drop a basic network/diagram and SSO type (SAML/OIDC) ahead of time that would help.

Zoom & calendar invite will be posted once you confirm a slot.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sec_readme.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@NimbusHealth.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, procurement@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 19:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review + onboarding window for Redwood integration

Alex — Monica here, thanks for sending the questionnaire. I can take Option A (Tue 30 Nov 15:00 PST).

Notes / small asks:
- Markus will lead the technical portion; please confirm if you'll have a cloud architect or infra engineer on the call (names helpful).
- Procurement: understood they will join the first 15m. If procurement prefers a separate short call for commercial terms, we can schedule that after the technical session.
- I'll add a 10-minute follow-up block for any outstanding evidence requests the week after if needed.

I'll create the calendar invite and add the Zoom link once Alex confirms final attendee list.

Thanks — Monica
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@NimbusHealth.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review + onboarding window for Redwood integration

David / Alex — marking availability and sharing a couple of things we'll present. Option A (Tue 30 Nov 15:00 PST) works for me.

Pre-reads I'll surface in the session:
- Redwood SOC2 summary (attached)
- Data classification & retention bullets (we'll cover on call)
- SSO patterns we support (SAML + OIDC), typical provisioning flows

A couple items to ask ahead of time so we can tailor the walkthrough:
- A one-page network/architecture diagram (public cloud / VPC layout) — even a whiteboard snapshot is fine
- Which SSO provider and whether you plan to use Just-in-Time provisioning or SCIM
- Any regulatory constraints (e.g., HITRUST / PHI handling) we should highlight

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

On the call we'll avoid deep code-level detail; focus will be on boundaries, telemetry, and evidence types. If procurement needs any certification matrix ahead of time, I can attach that after the call.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Security & Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@NimbusHealth.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@NimbusHealth.com, security@NimbusHealth.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: security review + onboarding window for Redwood integration

Thanks everyone — confirming Option A: Tue 30 Nov 15:00–15:45 PST. Apologies for the slightly delayed confirm; procurement moved a few internal items. Final attendee list:
- Alex Turner, Head of Integrations (NimbusHealth)
- Jamie Lowe, Cloud Security Engineer (security@NimbusHealth.com)
- Procurement (procurement@NimbusHealth.com) — will attend first 15min

Redwood attendees: Monica (AE), David (AE backup), Markus (Security/SE) — perfect.

I've added the calendar invite and Zoom (below). Procurement will drop after the first 15. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777?pwd=securelink
Calendar invite: (added)

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Integrations
NimbusHealth
